status: The review finding on original save/conversion error precedence is closed on the committed tree: stale version, non-draft state and foreign/missing party now return the generic CONFLICT at the command-assertion boundary, duplicate Money (23505) maps to CONFLICT, and a fresh quotation conversion writes the Finance order-revision total with replay/stale rollback. The selected-route suite and a clean full-service archive test/build pass; sales/quotes returns to verified.

reviewFindingClosed.finding: A later full TypeScript/PostgreSQL oracle exposed save error precedence differences involving stale versions, product, party and immutable Money guards; conversion also needed its Money error precedence checked.
reviewFindingClosed.resolution: The native save/transition now matches the original TypeScript command-assertion semantics: version/state/prerequisite failures and foreign/missing party return the generic CONFLICT, not COMMERCE_ORDER_CHANGED/PARTY_INVALID; a duplicate Money primary key also maps to CONFLICT. Product and price-list pre-read errors remain 422. A fresh quotation conversion writes the Finance sales-order total (sourceId <salesId>:1) on the native path only, replays without duplication and leaves order/Money unchanged on a stale conversion. The selected-route suite covers foreign party/product/list, stale update, credit-versus-stale approval, conversion before/after CAS, cancellation rollback, Money lock/permanent-failure/serialization retry and append-only revisions.

compositionFix.problem: The private development assembly created one Commerce target per configured Company on the same Holding host/slug, so a multi-Company document could not mount the selected-route suite, and Finance asset-cost construction used the wrong clock shape.
compositionFix.fix: Build one Commerce target with the full Company set via CommerceConfiguration::for_companies, include Commerce in the package-catalogue gate, and pass the shared clock to FinanceAssetCost. No business authority was widened; the selected route still requires the normal Account session and selected Company/branch/department context.
